title: Camouflage Tape 3-Pack – Self-Adhesive Fabric 5 × 450 cm
descriptionHtml:
Shiny gear can be seen from farther away than you can.

The binoculars, the flashlight, the tripod – anything with a shiny surface flashes in the sun. And ordinary tape that hides it leaves a sticky residue that never comes off.

Fabric that hides your gear without adhesive on the surface

Wrap the fabric around the binoculars, flashlight or tripod – it sticks to itself, not to the gear, and leaves no residue when you remove it. Three rolls of 5 × 450 centimeters are enough for several items, and the stretchy fabric follows round shapes.

Features

  • No shiny surfaces left – matte fabric in camouflage pattern
  • No adhesive residue – the fabric sticks to itself, not to the gear
  • Follows round shapes – stretchy fabric for handles, binoculars and tripods
  • Goes a long way – 3 rolls × 450 cm in every pack
  • Pattern to match the ground – jungle, ACU, snow or desert

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
